name: dstack
description: Rigorous engineering workflows: playbook routing, twenty-two principles, multi-reviewer design and review, and unslopped prose. Ported from cursor/plugins pstack.

interface.longDescription: Match a task to a playbook, apply twenty-two engineering principles, explore design in parallel, review adversarially, verify against the real artifact, and write prose with the AI tells removed. Ported from Lauren Tan's pstack for Cursor.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use dstack-mode to work on this task with rigor.
